subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should this PR be merged once check-lint is rerun or cleared, accepting the new announceLastRun persisted marker and tool-free announce handoff boundary?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it deliberately changes recovery behavior for persisted running sessions and tightens a security-sensitive tool boundary; automation cannot decide that product/runtime risk for maintainers.

options.title: Accept after lint rerun
options.body: Rerun or clear the hosted lint failure, accept the session-state and tool-boundary semantics, and proceed with merge.

options.title: Request more upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for additional restart-upgrade proof covering stale or mixed restartRecoveryRuns plus announceLastRun before merge.

options.title: Pause for redesign
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want announce delivery state represented without adding a new persisted session flag.

recommendation.title: Accept after lint rerun
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear the hosted lint failure, accept the session-state and tool-boundary semantics, and proceed with merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest recent history across the session lifecycle and Codex app-server surfaces touched by the risk decision.
